translated_title: National Mobilization Called to Reject Water Agreement Between Chihuahua and Israel
original_title: Convocan movilización nacional para rechazar convenio hídrico entre Chihuahua e Israel
author: Jesús Estrada
meta_description: Chihuahua's right-wing PAN government signed the Israel water pact without registering it with Mexico's federal foreign ministry; groups in 14 states march August 1 to cancel it.
